_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the site's core PL head-term in titles/meta/H1 for the homepage and generator hub pages — it is already the primary target and is natural, not stiff.
phrases.good_example: Ładne Czcionki i Stylowy Tekst do Skopiowania — Literki na Insta, TikToka i Nicki (locales/pl.json meta.title)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not stuff into platform-specific pages that already own a narrower head term (e.g. czcionki-na-instagram should lead with its own platform phrase, not duplicate the homepage title).

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for library/symbol-collection pages aimed at nickname decoration (Discord, Roblox symbol libraries).
phrases.good_example: Symbole Discord — kopiuj i wklej znaki do nazw kanałów i profili (pl/library/symbole-discord/index.html title)
phrases.avoid_when: Not the right term for single-glyph identity pages (symbol/) — there the item's own name is the primary term.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the site's own invisible-character tool page; keep as the umbrella term and use PL-005 (niewidzialny nick) as the gaming-specific long-tail variant within FAQ/intro copy.
phrases.good_example: Niewidzialny Znak (Niewidzialny Tekst) — Kopiuj i Wklej Pustą Spację (pl/niewidzialny-znak/index.html title)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this is the site's own umbrella term, safe everywhere on the page it already lives on.

phrases.usage_guidance: Safe as an occasional informal synonym for 'nick'/'nazwa' in FAQ/intro copy on usecase and generator pages — already used this way once on-site.
phrases.good_example: "Najprostszy sposób to imię lub ksywka w środku i ozdobniki po bokach, na przykład ✦ Zosia ✦" (pl/ozdobniki/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid in formal/technical copy (symbol/ codepoint pages, guide/ platform-rules explainers) where 'nazwa' or 'nick' reads more neutral.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use when explaining Discord's own field naming ('zmień pseudonim na tym serwerze') — matches Discord's actual PL client wording, so it is the technically correct term there, not just a style choice.
phrases.good_example: "kliknij prawym przyciskiem na serwerze i zmień pseudonim na tym serwerze" (pl/czcionki-discord/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — safe standard term, already used correctly.

phrases.usage_guidance: Critical distinction to keep explicit on every Roblox/Discord name page: styled Unicode goes in 'nazwa wyświetlana', never in '@nazwa użytkownika' (PL-010). Already handled correctly and repeatedly site-wide.
phrases.good_example: "Tak, ale tylko w nazwie wyświetlanej (display name) — czyli tej, którą widzą inni gracze w grze" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html FAQ)

phrases.usage_guidance: Always pair with PL-009 when explaining why a styled name 'didn't save' — the site already does this correctly and it is the single most common troubleshooting question across platform pages.
phrases.good_example: "@Nazwa użytkownika (do logowania) przyjmuje wyłącznie litery, cyfry i jedno podkreślenie, bez żadnych symboli" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html)

phrases.usage_guidance: Keep as the site's primary umbrella term for its own decoration-picker feature; it is natural (not a forced coinage — 'ozdobnik' is a real, generic Polish word for a decorative element) and already load-bearing across the UI tab labels.
phrases.good_example: Ozdobniki do Skopiowania ✦ Symbole do Nicku (kopiuj i wklej) (pl/ozdobniki/index.html title)

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for any UI/copy referring to wraparound name-decoration symbols; already a tab label and section heading on-site.
phrases.good_example: "Ramki i symbole do nicku" (pl/ozdobniki/index.html H3); decoration tab label in locales/pl.json ('frames': 'Ramki')

phrases.usage_guidance: Already correct on the Roblox names page section; the same term applies 1:1 to CS:GO/CS2 clan tags if the site ever expands gaming-name content to that game.
phrases.good_example: "Krótkie Nazwy i Tag Klanu" — "Krótkie, łatwe do zapamiętania, mieszczą się w nazwie wyświetlanej i na czacie klanu" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html)

phrases.usage_guidance: Use when describing pre-authored name examples on any gaming-name page; matches the CLAUDE.md 'Ready-Made Names' pattern already used in EN.
phrases.good_example: "Gotowe listy nazw — zadziorne, słodkie i na tag klanu" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html meta description); H2 "Gotowe Fajne Nazwy do Robloxa (Kliknij, by Skopiować)"

phrases.usage_guidance: The site's single most-repeated troubleshooting term (appears on 15+ pages) — keep using it exactly as-is; it is the correct, natural word and matches how PL users describe this exact symptom.
phrases.good_example: "Dlaczego niektóre ozdobniki pokazują się jako kwadraciki? Kwadracik (□) pojawia się, gdy telefon lub przeglądarka osoby oglądającej nie ma czcionki, która rysuje dany znak." (pl/ozdobniki/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not conflate with krzaczki (PL-016) — kwadracik is a missing-glyph fallback box, krzaczki is garbled/wrong-encoding text. Keep the distinction when writing new troubleshooting copy.

phrases.usage_guidance: Keep as the standard, warm way to explain the diacritic-coverage limitation across every style-generator FAQ — it's genuinely how Poles refer to this (the 'tails'/'hooks' under/over letters), not a site invention.
phrases.good_example: "możesz zapisać je bez ogonków i kresek (np. „pieknie” zamiast „pięknie”)" (pl/estetyczne-czcionki/index.html FAQ); also used in pl/usecase/czcionki-tatuaze/index.html: "przetestuj też wersję bez ogonków, np. «milosc»"

phrases.usage_guidance: Keep using specifically in impersonation/moderation-risk explanations (Discord name-safety guide) — do not use it for ordinary decorative-symbol content, where it would wrongly imply risk.
phrases.good_example: "użycie znaków-podróbek, by blisko naśladować innego prawdziwego użytkownika, członka administracji albo zweryfikowaną markę" (pl/guide/bezpieczna-nazwa-na-discordzie/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not apply to normal stylized fonts/ozdobniki — this term is specifically about deceptive lookalike use, and using it near unrelated decoration content would wrongly scare users.

phrases.usage_guidance: Correct, standard term for the ban-risk explanation on Discord name-safety content — no change needed.
phrases.good_example: "To problem podszywania się, nie stylu" (pl/guide/bezpieczna-nazwa-na-discordzie/index.html)

phrases.usage_guidance: Correct as-is for explaining the autocomplete/mention-matching failure mode of decorated names.
phrases.good_example: "Dlaczego nikt nie może mnie @oznaczyć, choć moja nazwa wygląda normalnie?" (pl/guide/bezpieczna-nazwa-na-discordzie/index.html FAQ question)

phrases.usage_guidance: Already the correct, natural term for the site's character-counter tool; no change needed.
phrases.good_example: "sprawdzian limitów dla 26 platform" (pl/licznik-slow-i-znakow/index.html meta description)

phrases.usage_guidance: Core, ubiquitous CTA phrasing — already used correctly and consistently across nearly every page (title tags, button labels, instructions). Do not vary it without reason.
phrases.good_example: "Kliknij symbol, aby od razu go skopiować" and title-tag "kopiuj i wklej" pattern used across all library/ pages
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this is appropriately high-frequency, not overused, since each page independently needs its own copy CTA.

phrases.usage_guidance: Preferred default over the borrowed 'vibe' (PL-024) for most copy — it reads native rather than youth-slang-borrowed, so it's safer for a broader audience while still capturing the same idea.
phrases.good_example: "100+ gotowych zestawów emoji, które nadają Twojemu bio, statusowi i opisom jeden klimat" (pl/kombinacje-emoji/index.html hero tagline)

phrases.usage_guidance: Fine in casual/example copy (e.g. showing 'Good vibes only' as a sample phrase) or informal teaser text — do not use in headings/titles or formal guide copy, where 'klimat' (PL-023) is the safer default.
phrases.good_example: "Zwykły tekst: Good vibes only ← Kaligrafia Unicode: 𝒢𝑜𝑜𝒹 𝓋𝒾𝒷𝑒𝓈" (pl/czcionki-na-snapchat/index.html example); "literki, które grają z twoim vibe'em" (locales/pl.json guides.items.1.description)
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid in symbol/ identity pages, guide/ authority content, or any legal/technical FAQ — register mismatch.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary hub term, already correctly used site-wide including as the H1/title of the dedicated hub page — keep as the anchor term for this whole content family.
phrases.good_example: Estetyczne Czcionki Generator — ａｅｓｔｈｅｔｉｃ tekst do skopiowania (pl/estetyczne-czcionki/index.html title)

phrases.usage_guidance: Good phrase to extend to gaming-name pages too — forum evidence confirms the same underlying concern (over-decorated names read as chaotic/hard to read) independent of the site's own copy.
phrases.good_example: "Polecam zacząć od jednego stylu i dorzucić jeden ozdobnik — nie wszystko naraz" and "tylko nie przesadzaj — całe CV w gotyku nie wygląda profesjonalnie" (locales/pl.json FAQ)

phrases.usage_guidance: Already used naturally and repeatedly as the 'why' hook across meta descriptions and headings; keep it as the go-to motivational verb.
phrases.good_example: "kopiuj i wklej znaki do nazw kanałów i profili" pages consistently frame value as helping profiles "wyróżnić się"; "Symbole Roblox — sprawdzone pod kątem aktualnego filtru nazw" section context (pl/library/symbole-roblox/index.html)

phrases.usage_guidance: Good reusable style-category label for gaming-name content beyond Roblox (Free Fire, Discord names) — currently only appears once, in the Roblox meta description, not reflected in the page's own H3 category labels ('Styl OG i Flex' is used there instead).
phrases.good_example: "Gotowe listy nazw — zadziorne, słodkie i na tag klanu" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html meta description)
